blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Following the death of former Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) star Peter June “PJ” Simon, sporting events here could face calls for stronger medical emergency safeguards. This comes after the City Council approved recommendations urging organizers to prepare trained responders, emergency equipment, and protocols for cardiac emergencies.
